thesis: The speakers argue that Cursor succeeded early because it maintained a narrow focus on VS Code while competitors pursued science fiction concepts like creating autonomous software engineers or rewriting editors. They also explain that their initial attempt to build a company for mechanical engineering and CAD systems failed due to a difficult cold-start problem and a lack of understanding of the domain, which led the founders to pivot back to programming.
